Finding: A security roadmap exists in slides but is not approved by management or linked to business goals.
Recommendation: Formalize a 2-year strategy and get board approval.

Finding: A Security Lead exists but reports to the Head of IT Ops, not independently.
Recommendation: Create a cybersecurity function reporting to senior management and a steering committee.

Finding: Policies are outdated and unapproved.
Recommendation: Approve the new policy set (Project 2) and review it yearly.

Finding: No documented RACI for security tasks.
Recommendation: Document roles and responsibilities and include them in job descriptions.

Finding: No risk register or risk methodology before this project.
Recommendation: Adopt the risk methodology and register from Project 1; review quarterly.

Finding: Security reviews happen for some releases but are not mandatory.
Recommendation: Add security requirements and review gates to the project lifecycle (secure SDLC).

SubdomainName: Compliance with Cybersecurity Standards, Laws and Regulations
Finding: Regulatory requirements are known informally but not tracked.
Recommendation: Maintain a compliance obligations register.

Finding: No internal or independent security audit has been performed.
Recommendation: Schedule a yearly independent cybersecurity review.

Finding: Background checks are done; offboarding does not always disable access the same day.
Recommendation: Link HR offboarding to automatic account disabling; signed AUP and NDA for all staff.

Finding: Onboarding training only; no phishing simulations.
Recommendation: Yearly training plus quarterly phishing simulations.

Finding: Cloud assets are listed; laptops and SaaS tools are not fully inventoried.
Recommendation: Maintain a complete asset inventory with owners and classification.

Finding: SSO in place; MFA only for engineers; no access reviews.
Recommendation: MFA for all users, PAM for admins, quarterly access recertification.

SubdomainName: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
Finding: Antivirus on laptops; no EDR on servers.
Recommendation: Deploy EDR on servers and laptops; harden baseline configurations.

Finding: Email filtering, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC are configured.
Recommendation: Keep monitoring; add a phishing report button.

Finding: Cloud networks are segmented; office network is flat.
Recommendation: Segment the office network and restrict management access.

Finding: MDM covers company phones, not laptops.
Recommendation: Enroll all laptops in MDM with full disk encryption and remote wipe.

Finding: Customer data is encrypted in the database; no data classification or DLP.
Recommendation: Introduce data classification and DLP for customer data.

Finding: TLS 1.2+ for all traffic; keys managed in the cloud KMS.
Recommendation: Document a cryptography standard and key rotation schedule.

Finding: Daily backups run; restores are never tested; no immutable copy.
Recommendation: Apply the Backup and Recovery Policy (Project 2), including monthly restore tests.

Finding: Scans run occasionally; no patching deadlines.
Recommendation: Monthly scans and patch SLAs based on severity (CVSS).

Finding: No penetration test has been performed.
Recommendation: Yearly external penetration test of internet-facing systems.

SubdomainName: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
Finding: Logs collected in a SIEM; only 30 days retention; no 24/7 monitoring.
Recommendation: 12-month retention, correlation rules, and a managed monitoring service.

Finding: No written incident response plan.
Recommendation: Write an incident response plan and playbooks; run a tabletop exercise.

Finding: Badge access, CCTV, and visitor logs at the office; production is in the cloud.
Recommendation: Review badge access lists quarterly.

Finding: Code reviews done; no WAF; no automated security testing.
Recommendation: Add a WAF and security testing in the CI pipeline.

SubdomainName: Cybersecurity Resilience Aspects of Business Continuity Management
Finding: No disaster recovery plan or BIA.
Recommendation: Complete the BIA and DRP (Project 4) and test them yearly.

Finding: Contracts include confidentiality clauses; no security assessment of vendors.
Recommendation: Security assessment before onboarding critical vendors; security clauses in contracts.

Finding: Hosted in a Saudi cloud region; no cloud security posture monitoring.
Recommendation: Enable configuration monitoring and document shared responsibilities with the provider.
